notes: Curated cases for the misleading-advertisement / dark-pattern scenario (Consumer Protection Act, 2019, informed by the CCPA's misleading-ads and dark-patterns guidelines). Each case runs the actual Pydantic validator + clause-selector + citation-resolution pipeline in complaint_drafter.py -- nothing here is mocked. dark_pattern_deceptive_design is expected to resolve against the corpus (Guideline 4 exists) but is flagged citation_review_required=true because its statutory characterization is framed in the alternative by the guideline itself, not a single direct Act provision -- see GOODS_CLAUSE_CITATIONS/ADS_CLAUSE_CITATIONS comments in complaint_drafter.py.

cases.description: Complete false-claim intake should validate and resolve to Section 2(28)(i).

intake.advertisement_or_practice_description: Print ad describing the cream as clinically proven to remove wrinkles in 3 days
intake.how_it_caused_loss: I purchased the cream for Rs. 1200 relying on this claim; it had no effect and no clinical study exists.

cases.description: Complete misleading-price intake should validate and resolve to Section 2(47)(i)(i).

intake.advertisement_or_practice_description: Website showed a struck-through 'original price' far higher than the item had ever actually sold for
intake.how_it_caused_loss: I paid Rs. 2000 believing I was getting a 60% discount that did not actually exist.

cases.description: Complete false-guarantee intake should validate and resolve to Section 2(28)(ii).

intake.advertisement_or_practice_description: TV ad promising a 5-year full replacement guarantee on the mixer
intake.how_it_caused_loss: The mixer failed after 6 months and the seller refused the promised replacement guarantee entirely.

cases.description: Complete surrogate-advertisement intake should validate and resolve to Guideline 6 of the misleading-ads guidelines.

intake.advertisement_or_practice_description: TV ad for 'Premium Soda Club' using the exact branding of a liquor brand whose direct advertising is restricted by law
intake.how_it_caused_loss: As a recovering alcoholic I was repeatedly exposed to disguised liquor-brand advertising, undermining my treatment.

expected_citation.section_cite: Guideline 6(1), read with the definition in Guideline 2(h)

cases.description: Complete dark-pattern intake should validate, resolve against the corpus, and be flagged for manual citation review.

intake.advertisement_or_practice_description: Checkout page auto-added travel insurance with a pre-ticked box before payment
intake.how_it_caused_loss: I was charged Rs. 499 extra for insurance I never selected or wanted, discovered only after payment.

expected_citation.section_cite: Guideline 4, read with the definition in Guideline 2(e)
